Home / People / Django Davidson Portfolio Manager Django Davidson University of Oxford, BA Django Davidson is a Portfolio Manager and Partner, joining at the inception of Hosking Partners. Django spent his first three years working alongside Jeremy in Dublin before moving to London. Prior to joining Hosking Partners, Django was a Partner at Algebris Investments LLP, one of the three funds backed by the Children’s Investment Fund (TCI). He began his career at Deutsche Bank, where he served as Director in the bank equity research team. A regular on the conference and podcast circuit, Django has presented at the London and New York Value Investor Conferences on multiple occasions and has spoken at the Ivey European Value Investing Conference, the Capstone Student Investment Conference and Value Spain. Django has featured as a guest on a number of podcasts, including Value Investing with Leg
